digo_source: ICRAF Useful Trees ('Digo: Mchofi'); Pakia 2005 Appendix III ('Mdzago', also counted among 'Mkoko')

teaser.en: Its seed sprouts while still hanging on the tree, and its hollow trunks have been turned into drums and beehives.
teaser.sw: Mbegu yake huota ikiwa bado inaning'inia mtini, na mashina yake yenye mvungu yamegeuzwa kuwa ngoma na mizinga ya nyuki.
teaser.dg: Tembeye inamera ichiri inabwadzika kpwa muhi, na makologe mahuphu gakahendwa ngoma na mizinga ya nyuchi.

summary.en: *Mchofi*, the black mangrove, is an evergreen tree of the quieter inner mangroves, with red bell-shaped flowers and knee-like roots. It gives some of the coast's best firewood and charcoal, poles, paddles, dye and dark, salty mangrove honey.
summary.sw: *Mchofi* ni muia, mti wenye majani mwaka mzima wa sehemu tulivu za ndani za mikoko, wenye maua mekundu yenye umbo la kengele na mizizi inayofanana na magoti. Hutoa baadhi ya kuni na makaa bora zaidi ya pwani, nguzo, makasia, rangi na asali ya mikoko iliyokolea yenye ladha ya chumvi.
summary.dg: *Mchofi* ni mkoko wenye makodza chila wakati wa mikoko ya ndani ambako madzi ganatulia, wenye maruwa ga kundu ga umbo ra kengele na mizi dza magoti. Unalavya kuni na makala nono zaidi za pwani, nguzo, makasia, rangi na asali nyiru ya munyu ya mikoko.

about.en:
*Mchofi* is an evergreen mangrove of 5 to 9 metres. Around its base, the roots loop up out of the mud and back down again, forming bent 'knees' that let the tree breathe in waterlogged ground. The leaves are glossy, leathery and pointed.

The flowers are striking: red, bell-shaped and hanging singly, with a many-pointed calyx like a little crown. As in the red mangrove, the seed germinates while it is still on the tree and hangs down as a long green seedling, ready to drop and root in the mud.
about.sw:
*Mchofi* ni mkoko wenye majani mwaka mzima wenye urefu wa mita 5 hadi 9. Kuzunguka kitako chake, mizizi huchomoza juu kutoka matopeni kwa mapindi na kurudi chini tena, ikiunda 'magoti' yaliyopinda yanayouwezesha mti kupumua katika ardhi iliyojaa maji. Majani yanang'aa, ni magumu kama ngozi na yana ncha.

Maua yake yanavutia sana: mekundu, yenye umbo la kengele na yanayoning'inia moja moja, yakiwa na kikombe cha ua chenye ncha nyingi kama taji dogo. Kama ilivyo kwa mkoko, mbegu huota ikiwa bado mtini na huning'inia chini kama mche mrefu wa kijani, tayari kuanguka na kuota mizizi matopeni.
about.dg:
*Mchofi* ni mkoko wenye makodza chila wakati wa mita 5 hadi 9. Kanda-kanda ya kolore, mizi inatuluka dzulu kula matopeni na kuuya photsi tsena, ichihenda 'magoti' ganagootyoka ambago ganaricha muhi uphahe pumuzi kpwa tsi iriyodzala madzi. Makodza ganang'ala, ni mafu dza chingo na gana ntsa.

Maruwa ni ga ajabu: ga kundu, ga umbo ra kengele na ganabwadzika mwenga-mwenga, na ganakala na chikombe cha ntsa nyinji dza tadzi ndide. Dza kpwa mkpwoko, tembe inamera ichiri kpwa muhi na inabwadzika photsi dza mutse mure wa chijani, tayari kugbwa na kumera matopeni.

where.en: It grows in the inner, less exposed parts of the mangrove and along creeks, where the water is calmer and the mud is firm. Around Gazi and Vanga it is scattered among the other mangroves rather than forming wide stands. The red flowers make it easiest to pick out.
where.sw: Hustawi katika sehemu za ndani za mikoko zisizo wazi sana na kando ya hori, ambako maji ni tulivu zaidi na matope ni imara. Kuzunguka Gazi na Vanga umetawanyika kati ya mikoko mingine badala ya kuunda misitu mipana ya aina yake peke yake. Maua mekundu ndiyo yanayourahisisha kutambuliwa.
where.dg: Unamera kpwa seemu za ndani za mikoko zisizo wazi sana na kanda-kanda ya mikpwono ya bahari, ambako madzi ganatulia na matope ni magumu. Kanda-kanda ya Gazi na Vanga ukatawanyika kahi ya mikoko yanjina, si kpwa makundi manji. Maruwage ga kundu ndigo ganahenda ukale rahisi kuumanya.

uses.en:
*Mchofi* is valued above all as fuel: it makes high-quality firewood and charcoal. Its straight stems serve as poles and roof supports, and the wood is shaped into paddles, oars and tool handles.

The bark gives a black dye and tannin. Hollow trunks are made into drums and beehives, and the flowers are good bee forage; mangrove honey from the coast is dark and slightly salty.
uses.sw:
*Mchofi* unathaminiwa zaidi ya yote kama nishati: hutoa kuni na makaa ya ubora wa juu. Mashina yake yaliyonyooka hutumika kama nguzo na viguzo vya paa, na mbao zake huchongwa kuwa makasia, kafi na mipini ya zana.

Gamba hutoa rangi nyeusi na tanini. Mashina yenye mvungu hutengenezwa ngoma na mizinga ya nyuki, na maua ni chakula kizuri cha nyuki; asali ya mikoko ya pwani ni ya rangi iliyokolea na yenye ladha ya chumvi kidogo.
uses.dg:
*Mchofi* nkutogolwa zaidi dza kuni: unalavya kuni na makala nono sana. Mihiye ya twaa nkuhumirwa dza nguzo na boriti za dzulu, na nyama za muhi nkutengezwa makasia, makafi na mipini ya vyombo vya kazi.

Gopha rinalavya rangi nyiru na tanini. Makolo mahuphu nkuhendwa ngoma na mizinga ya nyuchi, na maruwa ni chakurya chinono cha nyuchi; asali ya mikoko ya pwani ni nyiru na ina munyu chidide.

culture.en: The Digo group *mdzago* together with *mutsu* and *mkoko* as *mikoko*, the mangroves, a family of trees that the coast depends on for poles and fuel.
culture.sw: Wadigo huweka *mdzago* pamoja na *mutsu* na *mkoko* kama *mikoko*, familia ya miti ambayo pwani inaitegemea kwa nguzo na nishati.
culture.dg: Adigo anaika *mdzago* phamwenga na *mutsu* na *mkoko* dza *mikoko*, jamii ya mihi ambayo pwani inaikuluphira kpwa nguzo na kuni.

names.en: The name *mchofi* is recorded in the ICRAF tree handbook, while Pakia's study of Digo plant names gives *mdzago*, also counting it among the *mikoko*. The two names need checking with speakers. In Swahili it is *muia* or *msindi*, also *mkoko wimbi*; in Giriama it is *mkoko*. In English it is the black or oriental mangrove, and botanists call it *Bruguiera gymnorrhiza*.
names.sw: Jina *mchofi* limerekodiwa katika kitabu cha mwongozo cha miti cha ICRAF, huku utafiti wa Pakia kuhusu majina ya mimea ya Kidigo ukitoa *mdzago*, na pia kuuhesabu miongoni mwa *mikoko*. Majina haya mawili yanahitaji kuthibitishwa na wazungumzaji. Kwa Kiswahili ni *muia* au *msindi*, pia *mkoko wimbi*; kwa Kigiriama ni *mkoko*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *black mangrove* au *oriental mangrove*, na wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Bruguiera gymnorrhiza*.
names.dg: Dzina *mchofi* rinaphahikana kpwa chitabu cha mihi cha ICRAF, ela utafiti wa Pakia wa madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo unapha *mdzago*, na piya unauolanga kahi ya *mikoko*. Madzina higa mairi ganahitaji kulolwa na atu anaogomba Chidigo. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *muia* au *msindi*, piya *mkoko wimbi*; kpwa Chigiryama ni *mkoko*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *black mangrove* au *oriental mangrove*, na asayansi a mimea anauiha *Bruguiera gymnorrhiza*.

conservation.en: It is globally Least Concern, but Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel; harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and communities at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are replanting mangrove forest.
conservation.sw: Kimataifa uko katika kundi la Wasiwasi Mdogo (Least Concern), lakini mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya nguzo na nishati; uvunaji hutolewa leseni na Shirika la Huduma za Misitu Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinapanda upya misitu ya mikoko.
conservation.dg: Duniani tauri hatarini, ela mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni; kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service, na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinaphanda matsaka ga mikoko luphya.
